board_title.text: Exam App — Desktop Multi-Screen Architecture & Workspace Exploration

board_subtitle.text: v0.1.0 · Low-fidelity Exploratory UI Sketch · 5 core screen states with 250px spacing

s1_note.text:
Screen 1: Home Dashboard
- Entry point & competition selector (DATAPREV & PPSA)
- High-level progress summary & active study targets
- Quick resumption into questions or mock exam

s2_note.text:
Screen 2: Questions Workspace
- Unified competition-scoped sidebar (DATAPREV active)
- Metadata link affordances (ID, subject, topic, year, board)
- Abstract question statement & lettered option radios (A-E)
- Immediate verification feedback & retry flow

s2b_banner.text: Screen 2.B: Questions with Collapsed Rail (Focus Practice)

s2b_note.text:
Screen 2.B: Collapsed Sidebar / Icon Rail
- 70px compact rail maximizes reading width to 1330px
- Icon anchors preserve instant switching between DATAPREV and PPSA
- Fast single-click expand toggle restores full sidebar

s3_banner.text: Screen 3: Mock Exam (Setup Dialog & Timed Focus Session)

s3_note.text:
Screen 3: Mock Exam Flow
- 3.A Setup Dialog: exam scope (Single vs Mixed), count, timer limit
- 3.B Focus Session: persistent countdown timer & distraction-free header
- 5x10 question navigation palette with answered/flagged states

s4_note.text:
Screen 4: Performance & Analytics
- Unified sidebar preserves competition context
- Overall accuracy KPIs (percentage, volume, mocks, pace)
- Subject proficiency bars & practice vs. mock comparison
- Targeted topic revision priorities
